- Tier 3 or no tier indicated : All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

Background

UNDP provides integrated programmatic, policy and financing solutions to realize the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). In this context, UNDP has created a Global Policy Network (GPN), a network of field-based and global technical expertise across a wide range of knowledge domains and in support of the signature solutions and organizational capabilities envisioned in the Strategic Plan. The Bureau for Policy and Programme Support (BPPS) and the Crisis Bureau (CB) are the two anchor Bureau of the GPN.

In this context, the newly established Governance, Rule of Law, and Peacebuilding (GRP) Hub, a joint endeavor with the Bureau for Policy and Programme Support (BPPS), provides leadership and advisory services to enhance UNDP’s impact on governance and peacebuilding, ensuring the integration of democratic governance and human rights into crisis response and recovery. The Hub aims to build an integrated portfolio collaboratively between the CB and BPPS and establish partnerships with various stakeholders including the UN System, IFIs, civil society, and the private sector.

Through Local Action, the GRP Hub seeks to contribute to peace and development, achieving a visible impact on communities and improving lives by delivering integrated solutions that harness global expertise and partnerships. The Local Action Unit works closely with local and regional governments as key development players, highlighting their role as public service implementers, as drivers of innovation and the closest institution to people.

Local and regional governments are already responsible of over 65% of the SDG targets, most of them linked to basic service provision from water, sanitation, mobility, climate action, health or education. Cities and territories are playing a big part on the implementation of SDGs, that are becoming a new tool for strategic planning and budgeting in the mid to long-term. Since 2015, local governments and their associations have been increasingly active in promoting the SDGs through advocacy, working with their local population and partners in transposing the spirit of Agenda 2030 in cities and territories. Local Governments have also started to use SDGs as a strategic framework to deliver better and more innovative public services linked to SDG targets and indicators.

Within this context, the SDG Local Action project is seeking to recruit a Communications and Research Analyst to contribute to the design of contents and communications tools to highlight the role of local and regional governments in implementing Agenda 2030.

The Communications and Research Analyst will also support participant local and regional governments exchange on SDG implementation, contributing to generate knowledge and replication of successful experiences to implement Agenda 2030 at local level. Finally, the Analyst will also support the communication and research needs of the Mayors Challenge project.

Duties and Responsibilities

The Communications and Research Analyst will report to the Learning and Knowledge Generation Analyst, who works home based (CET time zone).

SDGs are genuinely interlinked with service provision at local level. To be able to deliver on Agenda 2030, local and regional governments are innovating on the way they plan, design and implement public policy. The Analyst will support UNDP cities and their partners to generate knowledge through the exchange of experiences, organizing international events and elaborating policy briefs and other communication materials. The Communications and Research Analyst will also liaise with the different UNDP project personnel globally to collect information, monitor and lessons learnt issued from the Mayors Challenge project.

The Communications and Research Analyst will support participant local and regional governments to communicate their stories, analyzing project data and providing narratives for targeted public segments: including local population, central governments and the international community.

Summary of functions:

1. Elaborate communications products for local and regional governments on SDG implementation solutions

- Draft and design content for the project and UNDP social platforms and project newsletter;

- Elaborate “SDG stories” about how local governments are implementing Agenda 2030;

- Elaborate content for learning exercises targeting the participating local governments.

2. Conduct research on innovative delivery of public services by local and regional governments

- Elaborate knowledge products on how local governments are contributing to SDGs by innovating public service delivery;

- Elaborate policy briefs and easy communicable knowledge materials on the lessons learnt by participating local governments;

- Promote exchange of experiences amongst local governments on how their peers are implementing the SDGs at local level.

3. Contribute to the SDG Local Action advocacy strategy to showcase the key role of local and regional governments for Agenda 2030

- Develop advocacy, visibility and promotional material that are necessary for the project;

- Analyze project data and link with SDG targets and Agenda 2030 narrative;

- Maintain and regularly update the project repository/archive of all communications material including photos videos and audios;

- Assist the Research Analyst to design and implement baseline surveys, public perception surveys, impact assessments/ tracking surveys including the development of survey report templates, design and layout of reports and related tasks;

- Assist the Research Analyst in gathering information to prepare the project metrics reports;

- Support the project team, including the UNDP Country Office staff in addressing their communications needs in regards to SDG local action.

4. Facilitate knowledge and capacity building, knowledge sharing and advocacy relevant to the assigned thematic area(s)

- Identify, synthesize and document best practices and lessons learned that are generated from the project and implementing partners.

Competencies

Core Competencies

- Achieve Results: LEVEL 1: Plans and monitors own work, pays attention to details, delivers quality work by deadline.

- Think Innovatively: LEVEL 1: Open to creative ideas/known risks, is pragmatic problem solver, makes improvements.

- Learn Continuously: LEVEL 1: Open minded and curious, shares knowledge, learns from mistakes, asks for feedback.

- Adapt with Agility: LEVEL 1: Adapts to change, constructively handles ambiguity/uncertainty, is flexible.

- Act with Determination: LEVEL 1: Shows drive and motivation, able to deliver calmly in face of adversity, confident.

- Engage and Partner: LEVEL 1: Demonstrates compassion/understanding towards others, forms positive relationships.

- Enable Diversity and Inclusion: LEVEL 1: Appreciate/respect differences, aware of unconscious bias, confront discrimination.

Cross-Functional & Technical Competencies

Business Management

- Communication: Ability to communicate in a clear, concise and unambiguous manner both through written and verbal communication; to tailor messages and choose communication methods depending on the audience. Ability to manage communications internally and externally, through media, social media and other appropriate channels

- Digital Awareness and Literacy: Ability and inclination to rapidly adopt new technologies, either through skilfully grasping their usage or through understanding their impact and empowering others to use them as needed.

Business Development

- Knowledge Generation: Ability to research information and to turn it into useful knowledge, relevant for context, or responsive to a stated need. Ability to apply existing concepts to new situations, and to develop new concepts to generate workable solutions and new approaches. Knowledge of relevant concepts, conceptual models, and theories that can be useful in addressing new situations.

Communications

- Campaign Management: Ability to produce and implement communications and advocacy campaigns which lead to impactful change.

- Creative direction and copywriting: Ability to creatively communicate concepts in an engaging and simple way.

- Media Relations: Ability to develop media relations across all aspects of media work including relationships with media and preparing media materials such as messages.

- Multimedia writing/editing: Ability to create and/or edit written content for multimedia.

Required Skills and Experience

Education:

- Advanced university degree (masters degree or equivalent) in Communications, Literature, History, Journalism, Social and Political Sciences, International Development or Urban studies is required; or

- A first-level university degree (bachelor’s degree) in the areas stated above, in combination with additional 2 years of qualifying experience, will be given due consideration in lieu of master´s degree.

Experience:

- Applicants with a master’s degree (or equivalent) in a relevant field of study are not required to have professional work experience.

- Applicants with a bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) are required to have a minimum of two (2) years of relevant professional experience in international development, communications or political and social issues, with at least one (1) year of experience working with urban related issues.

Desired Skills:

- Proven experience in working with local governments and their associations is an asset;

- Experience working on Agenda 2030 or other UN global agendas will be an asset;

- Proven professional experience in communications, advocacy, knowledge management, or knowledge generation related to urban development issues is an asset;

- Experience in the usage of computers and office software packages (MS Word, Excel, etc.) and social media assets (Canva, X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Bluesky or similar) is desired;

- Proven track record of strong analytical, written, verbal, interpersonal, and intercultural communication skills is desired.

Required Language(s):

- Fluency in English and Chinese language is required.

- Working knowledge of any other UN language is an asset.

Background

The Green and Inclusive Cities in Mongolia (GICM) Project is implemented under the National Implementation Modality (NIM), with the Ministry of Environment and Climate Change (MECC) serving as the implementing partner and UNDP providing implementation support, technical assistance, quality assurance, and oversight. Funded by the Global Environment Facility (GEF), the project supports national and local governments in accelerating the transition toward sustainable, resilient, low-carbon, and people-centered urban development. The project promotes integrated urban planning, climate-smart infrastructure, sustainable mobility systems, resource-efficient urban services, enhanced urban biodiversity, and accessible green public spaces. It also strengthens institutional capacities and inclusive governance mechanisms to ensure meaningful participation of citizens, communities, civil society organizations, the private sector, and vulnerable groups in urban development and decision-making processes. Through these interventions, the project contributes to creating greener, more resilient, and more inclusive cities that improve quality of life while advancing Mongolia's climate and sustainable development objectives.

The Eliminating Hazardous Chemicals from Supply Chains in Mongolia Project is implemented under the National Implementation Modality (NIM), with the Ministry of Food, Agriculture and Light Industry (MOFALI) serving as the implementing partner and the UNDP providing implementation support, technical assistance, quality assurance, and oversight. Funded by GEF, the project supports national efforts to reduce the use and release of hazardous chemicals across key economic sectors and supply chains.

The project seeks to strengthen the policy and regulatory framework for chemicals management, enhance institutional and technical capacities, improve industry practices, promote the adoption of safer and more sustainable alternatives, and increase transparency and accountability among public and private sector stakeholders. It also supports knowledge generation, awareness raising, and multi-stakeholder engagement to facilitate informed decision-making and responsible chemicals management throughout product life cycles. Through these interventions, the project contributes to reducing environmental pollution and health risks, advancing circular economy principles, and accelerating Mongolia's transition toward greener production systems and sustainable consumption patterns.

The Admin and Finance Associate will provide administrative, financial, and logistical support for the effective implementation of the GEF Funded projects of UNDP Mongolia. Under the direct supervision of the respective Project Managers and in close coordination with the UNDP Country Office operations team, the incumbent will support project budgeting, financial planning and reporting, travel and event logistics, asset and inventory management, records management, and compliance with UNDP, GEF, and national implementation modality (NIM) requirements. The Associate will ensure timely processing of financial transactions, maintain accurate project documentation, monitor expenditures against approved budgets, support project audits and reviews, and facilitate administrative coordination among implementing partners, government institutions, service providers, and other stakeholders to ensure efficient and accountable project delivery and achievement of project results.

UNDP adopts a portfolio approach to accommodate changing business needs and leverage linkages across interventions to achieve its strategic goals. Therefore, UNDP personnel are expected to work across units, functions, teams, and projects in multidisciplinary teams in order to enhance and enable horizontal collaboration.

The Administrative and Finance Associate provides integrated operational, financial, and administrative support to the Green and Inclusive Cities in Mongolia (GICM) Project and the Eliminating Hazardous Chemicals from Supply Chains in Mongolia Project, ensuring efficient implementation, compliance, and coordination across both GEF-funded initiatives. Working closely with Project Managers, implementing partners, and the UNDP Country Office, the Associate supports financial management, administrative processes, logistics, and reporting to facilitate the timely and accountable delivery of project results.

Under the overall guidance and direct supervision of the Project Managers, the Admin and Finance Associate is responsible for project implementation support services, ensuring effective operational management of the project and transparent utilization of financial resources. The Admin and Finance Associate promotes a collaborative, client-oriented approach consistent with UNDP rules and regulations. The Admin and Finance Associate works in close collaboration with the Project Implementing Unit (PIU) and the Country Office.

Background

The United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) is the UN’s global development network, advocating for change and connecting countries to knowledge, experience and resources to help people build a better life. We are on the ground in 170 countries and territories, working with governments and people on their own solutions to global and national development challenges to help empower lives and build resilient nations.

UNDP Turkmenistan was appointed by the Country Coordinating Mechanism (CCM) as the Principal Recipient (PR) for the Global Fund to fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria TB grant implementation in 2010. As the PR, UNDP is responsible for management and coordination of the implementation of the programme, monitoring and evaluation (M&E), and effective and transparent use of the Global Fund resources. Up to date UNDP has implemented TB grants with total budget more than $42 mln. The implementing partners of the grant: Ministry of Health (MoH), Ministry of Interior (MoI), World Health Organization (WHO), National Red Crescent Society (NRCS) and the National TB Programme. In 2025-2027 Turkmenistan implements Transitional TB grant aiming gradual phase-out from the Global Fund support in 2027-2030. In the transitional grant UNDP’s role will be to support MoH and NTP with building national policies and capacities to advance transition to full domestic funding of the TB grant and at the same time to ensure universal access to timely and quality diagnosis and treatment of all forms of TB.

Besides the Global Fund’s TB grant, UNDP country office implements financing agreements funded by MoH aiming at control of infectious diseases (TB, HIV, viral hepatitis, blood-born infections, sexually transmitted infections). Since 2017 UNDP implemented more than $69 mln Government funding for improving control of infectious diseases. The projects funded by the Global Fund and by the MoH are thematically combined and contribute to implementation of the plan for sustainability and transition of the National TB Programme to full domestic funding. The projects include technical assistance, capacity building, introduction of innovations for lab detection of infectious diseases, as well as procurement of quality-assured health products (reagents, commodities, medicines, medical equipment) for the needs of national programmes. Under the supervision of the Project Manager, the Laboratory Associate will lead on those activities implemented in collaboration with the national and international counterparts.

Duties and Responsibilities

Supply of lab reagents, consumables and equipment for TB and other infectious diseases:

- Follow up on proper implementation of diagnostic algorithms in the scope of the project.

- To assist national partners with preparation of the annual needs’ estimation for procurement of lab supplies for detection of TB and other infectious diseases (reagents for sputum microscopy, culture investigations, PCR, drug susceptibility testing, reagents for clinical lab tests, various consumables, PPE, lab equipment).

- To assist national partners with preparing specifications and quantification for procurement of lab supplies, compare the specifications and quantifications of lab reagents and consumables offered by the suppliers, provide inputs in clarification process.

- To assist national partners with preparing distribution lists for the delivered lab supplies; advise on re-distribution of lab supplies between laboratories as a preventive/corrective measure in case of risk of stockout or expiry of lab supplies at some labs.

- Monitor implementation and quarterly/annual reporting of national targets on testing, laboratory supply and quality control of laboratory services related to TB.

- To assist with preparing quarterly reports on stock of the lab supplies, analyze the reports and warn on potential stock-out or expiring items.

- To verify status of the lab equipment and physical count of inventory items provided by the project to laboratories.

- Participate in regular (quarterly and annual) monitoring visits to TB and other infectious diseases’ facilities across Turkmenistan for routine supervision and verification purposes.

Infection control, Quality Assurance, maintenance and calibration of lab equipment in TB and other infectious diseases laboratories:

- To identify and monitor the needs in maintenance and calibration of the lab equipment supported by UNDP projects.

- To support implementation of annual maintenance and calibration plans. The incumbent will be required to accompany engineers conducting various maintenance or calibration services.

- To assist national partners with implementing the necessary infection control measures. Contribute to implementation of the External and Internal Quality Assurance plans.

Facilitate capacity building and knowledge sharing

- To contribute to introduction of innovations for national counterparts, including specialized lab technologies and digital tools;

- To contribute to capacity building activities for the national implementing partners as per identified needs through formal training, on-site training, supervisory visits etc;

- Contribute to preparation of TORs and provides logistical support with organization of missions/trainings etc;

- To follow up recommendations of SNRL, WHO and other experts with regard to strengthening national TB and other infectious diseases’ laboratories.

- Provide sound contributions and support to knowledge networks, communities of practice, and digital knowledge platforms.

Perform other duties within your functional profile as assigned and deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the health projects.

Competencies

Core Competencies

- Achieve Results: LEVEL 1: Plans and monitors own work, pays attention to details, delivers quality work by deadline. Think Innovatively: LEVEL 1: Open to creative ideas/known risks, is pragmatic problem solver, makes improvements. Learn Continuously: LEVEL 1: Open minded and curious, shares knowledge, learns from mistakes, asks for feedback. Adapt with Agility: LEVEL 1: Adapts to change, constructively handles ambiguity/uncertainty, is flexible. Act with Determination: LEVEL 1: Shows drive and motivation, able to deliver calmly in face of adversity, confident. Engage and Partner: LEVEL 1: Demonstrates compassion/understanding towards others, forms positive relationships. Enable Diversity and Inclusion: LEVEL 1: Appreciate/respect differences, aware of unconscious bias, confront discrimination.

Cross-Functional & Technical competencies

Business Development

- Human-centered design Ability to develop solutions to problems by involving the human perspective in all steps of the problem-solving process. Knowledge and understanding of human centred design principles and practices.

- Knowledge Facilitation Ability to animate individuals and groups, internally and externally, and to design and facilitate activities, to share and exchange knowledge, information and ideas. Knowledge of tools and approaches to stimulate active participation, contribution, and exchange.

Business Management

- Results-based Management Ability to manage the implementation of strategies, programmes, and projects with a focus at improved performance and demonstrable results. Knowledge and understanding of relevant theories, concepts, methodologies, instruments, and tools.

- Working with Evidence and Data. Ability to inspect, cleanse, transform and model data with the goal of discovering useful information, informing conclusions and supporting decision-making.

2030 Agenda: People

- Health Sustainable financing for HIV and health. Universal Health Coverage. Procurement services of health products.

Required Skills and Experience

Education:

- Secondary education is required. Or

- A university degree in Biomedical Science or Medical Laboratory Science, Biology, Chemistry, or equivalent field will be given due consideration, but it is not a requirement.

Experience:

- Minimum of 7 years (with secondary education) or 4 years (with bachelor’s degree) of relevant professional experience in bacteriological or clinical laboratory performing laboratory testing and related functions.

- Working level of usage of computers and office software packages (MS Word, Excel, etc.).

Desired Skills:

- Experience in lab techniques for detection of TB, HIV, viral hepatitis or STI;

- Experience in procurement of laboratory reagents, consumables and equipment, specifically quantification of annual needs and/or developing quantities and specifications for bacteriological or clinical laboratories.

- Familiarity or experience with software for lab inventory and reporting.

Languages:

- Fluency in Russian and Turkmen is required.

- Working knowledge of oral and written English is an asset.

Equal opportunity

As an equal opportunity employer, UNDP values diversity as an expression of the multiplicity of nations and cultures where we operate and, as such, we encourage qualified applicants from all backgrounds to apply for roles in the organization. Our employment decisions are based on merit and suitability for the role, without discrimination.

UNDP is also committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all personnel are empowered to contribute to our mission, are valued, can thrive, and benefit from career opportunities that are open to all.

Sexual harassment, exploitation, and abuse of authority

UNDP does not tolerate harassment, sexual harassment, exploitation, discrimination and abuse of authority. All selected candidates, therefore, undergo relevant checks and are expected to adhere to the respective standards and principles.

Right to select multiple candidates

UNDP reserves the right to select one or more candidates from this vacancy announcement. We may also retain applications and consider candidates applying to this post for other similar positions with UNDP at the same grade level and with similar job description, experience and educational requirements.

Use of AI by candidates

Applicants are invited to read UNDP’s guidance for candidates on using AI responsibly in UNDP recruitment and selection

Scam alert

UNDP does not charge a fee at any stage of its recruitment process. For further information, please see www.undp.org/scam-alert.

jobs.title: Asistente de Edición - UCE - NPSA5
jobs.description:
1. Enfoque por niveles (Tiered Approach) para el reclutamiento

En línea con el compromiso de salvaguardar la capacidad y apoyar al personal que ya forma parte de la Organización, la mayoría de las vacantes de UNDP/UNCDF/UNV se publican utilizando un proceso de postulación por niveles, mediante el cual:

- Nivel 0 (Tier 0): Personal internacional (IP) de UNDP/UNCDF/UNV con contratos permanentes (PA) y de plazo fijo (FTA), cuyos puestos serán abolidos o cuyos contratos serán terminados o no renovados durante 2026.

- Nivel 1 (Tier 1): Otros funcionarios de UNDP/UNCDF/UNV con contratos permanentes (PA) y de plazo fijo (FTA).

- Nivel 2 (Tier 2): Personal de UNDP/UNCDF/UNV con contratos temporales (TA), personal con contratos PSA regulares, así como Voluntarios de la ONU en las categorías de Expertos y Especialistas.

- Nivel 3 (Tier 3) o sin nivel indicado: Todos los demás tipos de contrato de UNDP/UNCDF/UNV y de otras agencias, así como candidatos externos.

Por favor, tome nota del(los) nivel(es) indicado(s) en el título de la vacante, si corresponde, y asegúrese de cumplir con los criterios de elegibilidad para postular.

2. Oficina/Unidad/Descripción del Proyecto

PNUD es el organismo principal de las Naciones Unidas para el Desarrollo y cuenta con una posición única para apoyar la implementación de la Agenda 2030 y los Objetivos de Desarrollo Sostenible (ODS) a través del trabajo en más de 170 países y territorios. La Agenda 2030, aprobada por la Asamblea General de las Naciones Unidas en septiembre de 2015, orienta las políticas y la financiación del PNUD. Desde el año 2002, el Ministerio de Educación (MINEDUC) y el Programa de Naciones Unidas para el Desarrollo (PNUD) han establecido un marco de colaboración para apoyar el diseño e implementación de la política nacional en materia educativa, adaptando la estrategia a los desafíos en un contexto cambiante y complejo.

Uno de los objetivos del proyecto es apoyar el fortalecimiento de políticas públicas en educación, incluyendo el desarrollo y actualización del currículum educativo, alineado con las necesidades actuales y futuras de la sociedad, y orientado a asegurar herramientas pedagógicas adecuadas y eficientes para la formación integral de los estudiantes.

En el marco de la institucionalidad educativa, la Unidad de Currículum y Evaluación (UCE) cumple un rol técnico estratégico dentro del Ministerio de Educación, al desarrollar las definiciones curriculares y evaluativas que establecen los aprendizajes que deben alcanzar los estudiantes durante su trayectoria educativa. Asimismo, provee y resguarda la coherencia y alineamiento de los recursos educativos de apoyo para la implementación del Currículum Nacional.

Estas definiciones se expresan en instrumentos y documentos curriculares, evaluativos y pedagógicos elaborados, actualizados, revisados y difundidos por la UCE. Entre ellos se encuentran las Bases Curriculares, Programas de Estudio, Estándares de Aprendizaje, Textos Escolares y otros materiales dirigidos a los distintos actores del sistema educativo.

Dada la naturaleza técnica, pública e institucional de estos documentos, la se requiere la contratación de un(a) asistente de edición y corrección de estilo, con el fin de fortalecer la claridad, coherencia textual, consistencia terminológica, precisión lingüística, adecuación comunicativa y presentación formal de los documentos producidos.

3. Alcance del trabajo

El objetivo principal de este puesto es apoyar en los procesos de edición, corrección de estilo y revisión ortotipográfica de documentos elaborados por la UCE, resguardando el sentido técnico definido por los equipos especialistas y contribuyendo a la calidad formal, lingüística y comunicativa de los productos.

La prestación requerida comprende el apoyo editorial y lingüístico para mejorar la calidad, legibilidad y consistencia de los documentos elaborados por los equipos técnicos; no incluye la definición de contenidos curriculares ni la toma de decisiones técnico-pedagógicas sustantivas.

Entre las funciones y resultados esperados se encuentran:

A) Corrección y revisión editorial de contenidos

- Realizar la corrección ortográfica, gramatical, ortotipográfica y de estilo de documentos técnico-pedagógicos elaborados por la UCE.

- Revisar la claridad, coherencia, cohesión, fluidez, estructura, consistencia terminológica y adecuación comunicativa de documentos tales como Bases Curriculares, Programas de Estudio, orientaciones pedagógicas, documentos de apoyo curricular, informes técnicos, minutas, presentaciones y otros materiales producidos por la Unidad.

- Proponer ajustes de redacción que mejoren la comprensión de los textos, resguardando el sentido técnico-pedagógico definido por los equipos especialistas.

B) Edición y preparación de documentos para publicación y apoyo a la gestión del conocimiento en el proceso de edición

- Apoyar procesos editoriales mediante control de cambios, comentarios, revisión de versiones sucesivas, incorporación y consolidación de observaciones, sistematización de criterios editoriales, criterios de estilo y decisiones de edición recurrentes, y preparación de documentos para revisión interna, validación técnica, diagramación, publicación o difusión.

C) Coordinación y gestión del flujo del proceso editorial

- Coordinar ajustes editoriales con profesionales de la UCE, especialistas disciplinares, equipos técnicos, diseñadores/as, diagramadores/as u otras contrapartes definidas por la institución, asegurando una comunicación clara y oportuna sobre avances, observaciones y requerimientos.

- Planificar, organizar y ejecutar las tareas editoriales asignadas, resguardando el cumplimiento de los plazos, formatos, prioridades y mecanismos de entrega definidos por la contraparte técnica.

El/la titular desempeñará otras funciones dentro de su perfil funcional que se consideren necesarias para el funcionamiento eficiente del proyecto.

4. Acuerdo Institucional

Quien resulte seleccionado(a) se desempeñará en dependencias de la UCE del Ministerio de Educación ubicadas en Alameda 1146, Sector B, piso 4, Santiago, bajo la supervisión del Jefe/a de Gabinete de la Unidad. Por parte del PNUD, administrativamente corresponderá al Coordinador/a del proyecto la respectiva supervisión. Según se planifique, y de ser factible de acuerdo con los requerimientos del cargo y del área, podrá coordinarse una modalidad híbrida, respetando calendarización de reuniones semanales presenciales que se requieran con la contraparte técnica y/u otros coordinadores de equipos. La jornada laboral es completa en horario establecido por el proyecto. La UCE proveerá el equipo necesario para trabajar (computador).

5. Competencias

Competencias Esenciales

Lograr Resultados - NIVEL 1: Planea y monitorea su trabajo, poniendo atención a los detalles, realiza un trabajo de calidad y a tiempo.

Pensar Innovadoramente - NIVEL 1: Abierto(a) a nuevas ideas, conoce los riesgos, resuelve los problemas en forma pragmática, hace mejoras.

Aprender Continuamente - NIVEL 1: Curioso(a) y de mente abierta, comparte conocimiento, aprende de los errores, pide retroalimentación.

Adaptarse con Agilidad - NIVEL 1: Se adapta a los cambios, maneja la incertidumbre/ambigüedad constructivamente, es flexible.

Actuar con Determinación NIVEL 1: Demuestra manejo y motivación, capaz de afrontar la adversidad calmadamente, seguro(a).

Participar y Asociarse - NIVEL 1: Demuestra compasión/entendimiento frente a otros, forma relaciones positivas.

Facilitar la Diversidad y la Inclusión - NIVEL 1: Aprecia/respeta las diferencias, es consciente de los prejuicios, confronta la discriminación.

Competencias Funcionales y Técnicas

Gestión institucional - Comunicación

- Comunicarse de forma clara, concisa y precisa, tanto de manera escrita como verbal; personalizar los mensajes y seleccionar los métodos de comunicación según la audiencia. Capacidad para gestionar las comunicaciones internas y externas a través de los medios de comunicación, las redes sociales y otros canales apropiados.

Desarrollo institucional -Generación de conocimiento

- Capacidad para buscar información y convertirla en conocimiento útil, pertinente para el contexto o que responda a una necesidad planteada. Capacidad para aplicar los conceptos existentes a nuevas situaciones y desarrollar nuevos conceptos para generar soluciones viables y nuevos enfoques. Conocimiento de conceptos, modelos conceptuales y teorías relevantes que puedan resultar útiles para abordar situaciones nuevas.

Gestión de asociaciones - Gestión de relaciones

- Capacidad para relacionarse con un amplio abanico de asociados públicos y privados, así como para crear, mantener y reforzar las relaciones, la confianza y la comprensión mutua.

Comunicación - Redacción y edición

- Capacidad para crear y editar contenido escrito en los distintos idiomas de las Naciones Unidas.

Comunicación - Redacción y edición multimedia

- Capacidad para crear y editar textos escritos para productos multimedia.

Administración y operaciones - Gestión de documento y registros

- Gestión general de documentos (ya sean físicos o electrónicos); política de registro y conservación, incluido el almacenamiento y archivo.

Agenda 2030: Prosperidad - Crecimiento inclusivo

- Inclusión social.

6. Calificaciones mínimas de un NPSA

Educación académica mínima requerida

- Educación secundaria completa es requerida.

- Título profesional universitario (Grado de licenciado(a)) en Literatura o Lingüística, se dará debida consideración, pero no es un requisito.

Años mínimos de Experiencia laboral relevante

- Mínimo de 5 años (educación secundaria) o 2 años (con licenciatura) de experiencia relevante.

- Se entenderá por experiencia relevante al conjunto de experiencia laboral que incluya: - Experiencia en edición, corrección de estilo, corrección ortotipográfica, revisión lingüística o revisión de coherencia textual de documentos escritos (claridad, estructura, fluidez, consistencia terminológica, adecuación comunicativa, gramática, puntuación y uso formal del lenguaje). - Experiencia en edición, corrección o revisión de textos de no ficción, materiales educativos, textos escolares, publicaciones institucionales, manuales, informes, contenidos pedagógicos o materiales de divulgación. - Experiencia de participación en procesos editoriales, incluyendo revisión de originales, control de versiones, incorporación de observaciones, coordinación con autores, especialistas, equipos técnicos, diseñadores o contrapartes del proceso editorial.

Habilidades y competencias requeridas

- Experiencia en el manejo de herramientas editoriales o de diseño, como Adobe (Acrobat), InDesign o equivalentes.

- Experiencia en el manejo de herramientas de trabajo remoto y colaborativo, tales como Microsoft Teams, Zoom, Google Docs, Google Drive y nubes de almacenamiento.

- Experiencia en el manejo de herramientas tradicionales Microsoft Office: Word avanzado, Excel, Power Point.

Habilidades y competencias deseables

- Contar con grado o título superior en las áreas mencionadas (Literatura o lingüística).

- Experiencia relevante por sobre el mínimo requerido. Será considerada una ventaja contar con al menos 4 años de experiencia por sobre lo requerido.

- Experiencia en la redacción, edición técnica o corrección de estilo de libros, informes institucionales, documentos técnicos o contenidos editoriales.

- Experiencia en la aplicación de manuales de estilo, guías de redacción, glosarios terminológicos o pautas metodológicas para la estandarización y control de calidad en proyectos editoriales.

- Experiencia en la creación de manuales de estilo o guías de redacción.

- Experiencia en la organización y seguimiento de procesos editoriales, incluyendo la supervisión del cumplimiento de plazos, el trabajo con múltiples versiones, la revisión de observaciones y el trabajo colaborativo con contrapartes técnicas.

- Experiencia en traducción, cotraducción, revisión de traducciones o trabajo con bibliografía de otros idiomas.

Idiomas requeridos (a nivel laboral)

- Fluidez en el idioma español es requerida.

Certificados profesionales

Se exigirá a los/as postulantes acreditar mediante certificados u otros documentos similares su experiencia laboral en el manejo de las herramientas señaladas

7. Viajes:

El puesto, a priori, no considera viajes nacionales ni internacionales. Sujeto a requerimiento de la UCE.

8. Los siguientes documentos deben requerirse a los aplicantes:

- P11 y CV indicando los puestos anteriores y sus funciones, la duración (mes-año), los requisitos, así como los detalles de contacto (correo y número de teléfono) del (la) candidato(a), y al menos tres referencias laborales de supervisores o colegas previos. El/la postulante debe detallar su experiencia, indicando proyectos o documentos en los que ha trabajado.

- Una carta de presentación (máximo una página) indicando por qué la persona se considera idónea para la posición.

- Los gerentes pueden requerir cualquier otro material relevante de su experiencia como reportes, presentaciones, publicaciones, campañas u otros materiales. En lo particular del dominio del idioma español (castellano), se solicitará al postulante una muestra de al menos 30 páginas relacionadas con el ámbito de la educación.

Consideraciones en su postulación:

- Complete el formulario en línea; es requerido.

- Adjunte también CV en formato libre, como complemento.

- Incluya una carta de presentación (máximo una página) indicando por qué se considera idónea(o) para la posición.

- Identifique al menos tres referencias laborales de supervisores(as) anteriores. Las referencias pueden incluir también a los colegas.

- Por tratarse de una posición nacional, las personas extranjeras deben contar con las condiciones habilitantes para trabajar en el país (residencia, permiso) al momento de postular.

Importante

Esta posición en categoría NPSA está sujeta a reclutamiento local.

Vacante Tier 3, es decir, abierto a postulaciones internas y externas.

Igualdad de oportunidades

Como empleador que promueve la igualdad de oportunidades, el PNUD valora la diversidad como una expresión de la multiplicidad de naciones y culturas en las que operamos y, en ese sentido, alentamos a personas calificadas de todos los orígenes a postular a puestos dentro de la organización. Nuestras decisiones de empleo se basan en el mérito y la idoneidad para el puesto, sin discriminación.

El PNUD también está comprometido con la creación de un entorno laboral inclusivo, en el que todo el personal esté empoderado para contribuir a nuestra misión, sea valorado, pueda desarrollarse y beneficiarse de oportunidades de carrera abiertas a todos.

Acoso sexual, explotación y abuso de autoridad

El PNUD no tolera el acoso, el acoso sexual, la explotación, la discriminación ni el abuso de autoridad. Por lo tanto, todos los candidatos seleccionados se someten a verificaciones pertinentes y se espera que cumplan con los estándares y principios correspondientes.

Derecho a seleccionar a múltiples candidatos

El PNUD se reserva el derecho de seleccionar a uno o más candidatos de este anuncio de vacante. Asimismo, podemos conservar las postulaciones y considerar a los candidatos que apliquen a este puesto para otras posiciones similares en el PNUD, al mismo nivel de grado y con requisitos de funciones, experiencia y formación similares.

Uso de IA por parte de los candidatos/as

Los postulantes están invitados a leer la respectiva guía: read UNDP’s guidance for candidates on using AI responsibly in UNDP recruitment and selection

Alerta de fraude

El PNUD no cobra ninguna tarifa en ninguna etapa de su proceso de contratación. Para más información, consulte:

www.undp.org/scam-alert.

jobs.title: Programme Associate
jobs.description:
Tiered Approach

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:

- Tier 0 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.

- Tier 1: Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments

- Tier 2: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers

- Tier 3 or no tier indicated : All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

Background

The Spotlight Initiative is a global partnership between the United Nations (UN) and the European Union (EU) to eliminate all forms of violence against women and girls in support of the 2030 Agenda on Sustainable Development. It was launched in September 2017 by the UN Secretary General and the EU High Representative and Vice President as a model for partnerships with donors, civil society, and the UN to deliver on SDGs in a comprehensive manner. SDG 5 and the achievement of gender equality are placed at the center of efforts (alongside Goal 16) with the aim to provide an enabling environment for the implementation of all goals. Within the UN, the Initiative helps operationalize the UN development system reforms and model a new way of delivering on SDGs in an integrated way, leveraging stakeholders’ diverse comparative expertise and collaborative advantages.

In Liberia, the Spotlight Initiative ran from 2019 to 2023 and focused on addressing the root causes of sexual and gender-based violence, harmful practices, and violations of women's rights, including SRHR. Building on the knowledge and lessons from the first phase (2019-2023), Spotlight Initiative 2.0 is being implemented to consolidate the achievements and further galvanize crucial efforts to eliminate violence against women and girls.

To support this implementation, multi-stakeholder, and multi-year programme, a dedicated Programme Coordination and Management Unit (PMCU) has been established within the UN Resident Coordinator’s Office. In this context, the Resident Coordinator’s Office is seeking to recruit an Programme Associate to provide programme implementation support, stakeholder engagement, advocacy, knowledge management, reporting, and results tracking. The Programme Associate position has been created to strengthen support for programme delivery and achievement of results to support services to the Spotlight team based in the Resident Coordinator’s office, and as needed, to the Spotlight RUNOs technical team based in UNDP, UNFPA and UN Women.

Duties and Responsibilities

- Scope of Work (5 to 7 items only)

a. Programme implementation Support

- Support implementation follow-up of programme workplans, activities, decisions, commitments, and agreed actions to ensure timely delivery of results.

- Support programme implementation tracking, programme planning , and programme management review processes

- Support organization of meetings, preparation of agendas, briefing materials, presentations, participant lists, minutes, and action trackers.

- Support tracking of decisions from programme meetings and governance mechanisms.

- Support field missions’ preparations, and stakeholder engagements.

- Maintain a repository of programme decisions, commitments, action points, and key implementation documents to support institutional memory and accountability.

b. Stakeholder Engagement, Advocacy and Partnership Support

- Support efforts for stakeholder engagements

- Assist in organizing advocacy initiatives, dialogues, consultations, campaigns and various activities that advance Spotlight Initiative objectives.

- Support communication and information-sharing on spotlight initiative among stakeholders and beyond

- Support preparation of advocacy materials, briefing notes, talking points, presentations, position papers, and engagement packages.

- Document stakeholder commitments, recommendations, and agreed actions and monitor follow-up implementation.

- Support donor missions, visits, programme reviews, and other relevant engagements.

- Maintain stakeholder databases and partnership records to facilitate effective engagement and communication.

- Support efforts in preparation of stakeholder mapping and engagement updates to inform programme planning and partnership management.

c. Knowledge Management, Reporting and Learning

- Support documentation and dissemination of programme achievements, lessons learned, good practices, innovations, and success stories.

- Maintain programme knowledge repositories and ensure systematic filing and accessibility of programme information and documentation.

- Compile initial information and inputs from RUNOs for programme reporting purposes.

- Assist in preparation of progress reports, implementation updates, briefing notes, donor reports, and management information products.

- Contribute to the preparation of knowledge products highlighting programme results, impact, and emerging evidence.

- Contribute to programme advocacy through support in preparation of success stories, human-interest stories, event summaries, and other results-focused communication products, ensuring compliance with applicable UN and donor visibility requirements

d. Administrative Support

- Provide logistical and administrative support for programme activities, workshops, consultations, trainings, meetings, missions, and other stakeholder engagements.

- Support travel arrangements, mission planning, procurement requests, and other operational requirements in accordance with UN regulations and procedures.

- Maintain programme records and support documentation required for programme implementation, reporting, and audits.

- Facilitate coordination between the PMCU and relevant support units within participating UN agencies.

- Assist in tracking and maintaining programme documentation necessary for accountability and reporting purposes.

- Support organization of meetings, missions, programme reviews, and consultations, including preparation of logistical and administrative arrangements.

- Maintain accurate records of correspondence, official communications, meeting documentation, and programme files in accordance with UN records management requirements.

e. Event Management Support

- Support in coordination and management of programme events, including workshops, trainings, conferences, launches, consultations, and meetings, ensuring effective planning and implementation.

- Coordinate event logistics and operational arrangements, including venue selection, accommodation, transportation, catering, participant registration, and event invitations.

- Ensure that event materials, including participant packages, registration materials, presentations, visibility items, and other event-related documentation are timely available.

- Maintain event records, attendance lists, and related documentation to support programme accountability and institutional memory.

f. Program delivery

- Assist in monitoring and updating programme implementation delivery status against approved workplans and results budgets.

- Assist in identifying implementation delays, outstanding actions, and accountability gaps requiring management attention.

The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organization

- Institutional Arrangement

The Programme Associate will work under the direct supervision of the Spotlight Initiative Programme Specialist/Spotlight Initiative Coordinator. The incumbent will collaborate closely with other Spotlight Initiative Programme Management Team members, programme and operations teams of RUNOs, implementing partners, government counterparts, and other stakeholders, and will submit all outputs and deliverables to the supervisor for review and approval.

Competencies

Customer Satisfaction/Client Management- Ability to respond timely and appropriately with a sense of urgency, provide consistent solutions, and deliver timely and quality results and/or solutions to fulfil and understand the real customers' needs. Provide inputs to the development of customer service strategy. Look for ways to add value beyond clients' immediate requests. Ability to anticipate client's upcoming needs and concerns.

Project Management- Ability to plan, organize, prioritize and control resources, procedures and protocols to achieve specific goals

Strategic Thinking- Ability to develop effective strategies and prioritized plans in line with UNDP’s objectives, based on the systemic analysis of challenges, potential risks and opportunities; linking the vision to reality on the ground, and creating tangible solutions Ability to leverage learning from a variety of sources to anticipate and respond to future trends; to demonstrate foresight in order to model what future developments

Digital strategy - Ability to plan the use of resources through digital channels to reach and engage target audiences effectively and to achieve particular objectives . Ability to communicate clearly and effectively, including preparing reports, briefs, presentations and other programme-related materials.

Procurement management- The ability to acquire goods, services or works from an outside external source

Events management (including retreats, training and meetings)- Ability to manage events, including venue identification, accommodation, logistics, catering, transportation, and cash disbursements, etc.

Financial reporting and analysis- Understands changes in regulatory, legal and ethical frameworks and standards for financial reporting in the public sector. Ability to extract, evaluate financial data, derive relevant findings and present them in a meaningful and coherent manner to facilitate effective decision making and performance monitoring. Understands the benefits of integrated reporting, including non-financial resources such as human, social and intellectual capital, and environmental and governance performance

Required Skills and Experience

Education:

Secondary education is required.

OR

A university degree (Bachelor’s degree) in Business Administration, Public Administration, Accounting, Finance or Economics, Economics, Political Sciences, Social Sciences or related field will be given due consideration, but it is not a requirement.

Experience:

Minimum of 6 years of experience (with a High School Diploma) or 3 years of experience (with Bachelor’s degree) of relevant work experience, preferably in administration or programme experience or a related field, is required.

Demonstrated experience in providing programme support, including coordinating activities, maintaining programme documentation, following up on action points, and supporting the day-to-day planning and implementation of development programmes/projects is required.

Proven experience in programme monitoring and reporting, including compiling programme data and information, tracking activities and results, and contributing to progress reports and other programme-related documentation is required.

Demonstrated experience in stakeholder engagement and coordination, including supporting communication and follow-up with government institutions, development partners, UN agencies and other relevant stakeholders is required.

Experience in knowledge management and documentation, including organizing programme information, maintaining records, documenting good practices and lessons learned, and supporting the dissemination of programme knowledge is required.

Sound experience supporting gender equality, women's empowerment, gender-based violence prevention and response, human rights, or related development programmes, including coordination of activities, follow-up on implementation, maintenance of programme documentation, and tracking of results.

Proven familiarity with results-based management approaches and monitoring frameworks is required. Experience with EU-funded programmes or other donor-funded development programmes is an advantage.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to prepare clear and concise correspondence, briefs, presentations, meeting documentation and other official programme materials.

jobs.title: Associado de Pesquisa em Cibersegurança (1 vaga) (Home Based) - [Open to internal and external applicants]
jobs.description:
Tiered Approach

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:

- Tier 0 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.

- Tier 1 : Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments

- Tier 2 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers

- Tier 3 or no tier indicated : All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

Background

Em 2025, o Conselho Nacional de Justiça (CNJ) e o Programa das Nações Unidas para o Desenvolvimento (PNUD) firmaram uma parceria voltada à promoção da inovação em segurança cibernética para o Poder Judiciário. O projeto BRA/25/025 – “Fortalecimento da segurança cibernética e da transparência para governança e efetividade da atuação do Poder Judiciário” desenvolve e implementa ferramentas e estratégias para o fortalecimento da segurança cibernética, da preservação digital e da integridade da informação, ampliando a proteção dos sistemas e dos usuários do Judiciário.

A iniciativa fortalece a segurança institucional e promove a transparência, a boa governança e a eficiência dos processos judiciais, contribuindo para a economia de recursos e para uma atuação mais ágil da Justiça em benefício dos cidadãos e da sociedade.

Para isso, a governança do projeto está dividida nas seguintes frentes:

Quatro eixos transversais de coordenação:

- Coordenação Geral;

- Unidade de monitoramento e controle integrado;

- Unidade de gestão técnica e operacional;

- Unidade de formação e comunicação;

Quatro frentes de trabalho, focadas em:

- Compliance normativa;

- Conformidade operacional;

- Governança em rede;

- Fomento à cultura de segurança cibernética;

Por se tratar de uma vaga em regime remoto, espera-se que o(a) candidato(a) disponha de condições adequadas de trabalho, incluindo infraestrutura e equipamentos necessários para o pleno desempenho das atividades.

Deveres e responsabilidades

O(a) Associado(a) de Pesquisa em Cibersegurança estará vinculado(a) ao Eixo 4 – Fomento à Cultura de Segurança Cibernética, com atuação voltada à pesquisa aplicada para identificar desafios concretos, desenvolver e testar abordagens e soluções e apoiar sua adoção pelas instituições do sistema de Justiça. Desenvolverá estudos, provas de conceito e soluções inovadoras, incluindo o uso de inteligência artificial e outras tecnologias emergentes, com foco na geração de resultados aplicáveis e na sua validação em contextos institucionais reais.

As seguintes atividades indicativas estão previstas:

1. Pesquisa Aplicada e Prospecção Tecnológica

a. Conduzir pesquisas aplicadas em cibersegurança, identificando tendências, novas tecnologias e práticas emergentes. b. Avaliar tecnologias, metodologias e abordagens inovadoras que possam fortalecer a postura de segurança institucional. c. Acompanhar a evolução do cenário tecnológico e suas possíveis aplicações no contexto do Laboratório de Cibersegurança do Poder Judiciário.

2. Experimentação, Prototipagem e Desenvolvimento de Soluções

a. Desenvolver estudos, provas de conceito, protótipos e soluções inovadoras em parceria com o Blue Team e demais áreas técnicas. b. Planejar e executar experimentações e testes para avaliar a viabilidade, a eficácia e a aplicabilidade das soluções propostas. c. Colaborar na criação e no aprimoramento de ambientes de simulação, laboratórios virtuais e testbeds.

3. Inovação e Agenda de Pesquisa

a. Participar da definição de desafios, programas de inovação e agendas de pesquisa para o Laboratório de Cibersegurança do Poder Judiciário. b. Identificar oportunidades de pesquisa e desenvolvimento experimental alinhadas às necessidades institucionais. c. Contribuir para a priorização de iniciativas de inovação em cibersegurança.

4. Gestão do Conhecimento e Disseminação de Resultados

a. Documentar experimentações, testes, metodologias e resultados, consolidando conhecimento estruturado e replicável. b. Produzir relatórios técnicos, manuais, estudos e materiais de referência relacionados às pesquisas desenvolvidas. c. Promover a disseminação dos aprendizados, resultados e boas práticas para outras frentes e equipes.

5. Cooperação Técnica e Parcerias Institucionais

a. Estabelecer e fortalecer parcerias com instituições acadêmicas, órgãos públicos e grupos especializados. b. Apoiar a realização de iniciativas conjuntas de pesquisa, inovação e intercâmbio de conhecimentos. c. Articular a participação de especialistas e instituições parceiras em projetos e programas do Laboratório de Cibersegurança do Poder Judiciário.

6. Aplicação Institucional e Transferência de Inovações

a. Acompanhar a transição de inovações bem-sucedidas para ambientes produtivos ou programas internos. b. Apoiar as áreas técnicas na incorporação e aplicação dos resultados das pesquisas. c. Contribuir com insumos técnicos para campanhas de conscientização, critérios de certificação e outras iniciativas institucionais.

7. Internalização da Pesquisa em Cibersegurança

a. Promover o desenvolvimento de pesquisas técnico-científicas em cibersegurança, incluindo estudos sobre inteligência artificial, aprendizado de máquina e demais tecnologias emergentes. b. Incentivar a produção e a divulgação de artigos científicos, publicações técnicas e estudos especializados. c. Articular iniciativas de cooperação técnica e científica com instituições acadêmicas, centros de pesquisa, organismos internacionais e entidades especializadas estrangeiras. d. Viabilizar o intercâmbio de conhecimentos, metodologias e boas práticas em inovação em cibersegurança.

O(a) titular desempenha outras funções compatíveis com seu perfil funcional que considere necessárias ao bom funcionamento do projeto.

Arranjo Institucional

A pessoa contratada será supervisionada pela Analista de Gestão de Cultura de Segurança Cibernética.

Competências

- Alcançar Resultados - NÍVEL 1: Planeja e monitora seu próprio trabalho, presta atenção aos detalhes e entrega um trabalho de qualidade dentro do prazo.

- Pensar de forma Inovadora - NÍVEL 1: Aberto a ideias criativas e riscos conhecidos, é um solucionador de problemas prático e faz melhorias.

- Aprender Continuamente - NÍVEL 1: Mente aberta e curioso, compartilha conhecimento, aprende com os erros e pede feedback.

- Adaptar com Agilidade - NÍVEL 1: Adapta-se às mudanças, lida de forma construtiva com ambiguidades e incertezas, e é flexível..

- Agir com Determinação - NÍVEL 1: Demonstra determinação e motivação, mantém a calma diante da adversidade e tem confiança.

- Engajar e fazer Parcerias - NÍVEL 1: Demonstra compaixão e compreensão em relação aos outros, formando relacionamentos positivos.

- Promover a Diversidade e Inclusão - NÍVEL 1: Valoriza e respeita as diferenças, está consciente de vieses inconscientes e enfrenta a discriminação

Competências multifuncionais e técnicas

Direção e estratégia de negócios | Pensamento estratégico: Desenvolver estratégias eficazes e planos prioritários alinhados com a missão e os objetivos do PNUD, baseando-se em uma análise sistêmica de desafios, oportunidades e riscos potenciais; conectar a visão geral à realidade no campo para criar soluções tangíveis e direcionadas; aprender a partir de diversas fontes para antecipar e responder de forma eficaz às tendências atuais e futuras; demonstrar capacidade de previsão.

Direção e estratégia de negócios | Perspicácia Empresarial: Capacidade de compreender e lidar com situações de negócios de forma a alcançar bons resultados. Habilidade para tomar boas decisões e fazer julgamentos rápidos dentro de tais contextos. Conhecimento e compreensão dos marcos operacionais da organização.

Desenvolvimento de negócios | Design centrado no humano: Capacidade de desenvolver soluções para problemas envolvendo a perspectiva humana em todas as etapas do processo de resolução. Conhecimento e compreensão dos princípios e práticas de design centrado no ser humano.

Gestão de negócios | Gestão de Projetos: Capacidade de planejar, organizar, priorizar e controlar recursos, procedimentos e protocolos para alcançar objetivos específicos.

Digital | Gerenciamento de riscos de segurança cibernética e privacidade de dados: Capacidade de antecipar, preparar e responder a riscos e problemas que possam resultar em violações de dados, afetando a reputação do PNUD e causando danos pessoais.

Agenda 2030: Paz | Estado de Direito, Segurança e Direitos Humanos: Instituições Eficazes do Setor de Justiça.

Agenda 2030: Paz | Estado de Direito, Segurança e Direitos Humanos: Acesso à Justiça.

Habilidades e experiência necessárias

Requisitos mínimos de educação:

- Diploma do Ensino Médio completo é requerido.

- Diploma Universitário (Ensino Superior) em Direito, Ciência de Dados, Estatística, Tecnologia da Informação, Relações Internacionais e Segurança da Informação ou áreas afins será dada a devida consideração, mas não é um requisito.

Anos mínimos de experiência profissional relevante:

- Mínimo de 7 anos (para Ensino Médio) ou 4 anos (para Ensino Superior) de experiência profissional relevante em inovação e pesquisa aplicada em cibersegurança.

Habilidades requeridas:

- Experiência no uso do Pacote Microsoft Office e de ferramentas de tecnologia da informação;

Habilidades desejadas, além das competências abordadas na seção Competências:

- Experiência em inovação tecnológica, provas de conceito, ambientes de simulação, laboratórios virtuais, testbeds ou desenvolvimento experimental na área de cibersegurança.

- Experiência em projetos relacionados à inteligência artificial, aprendizado de máquina ou análise de dados aplicados à segurança cibernética.

- Experiência na elaboração de estudos, relatórios técnicos, artigos científicos ou outras publicações especializadas.

- Experiência em projetos de cooperação técnica ou científica com instituições acadêmicas, centros de pesquisa, órgãos públicos, organismos internacionais ou entidades estrangeiras

- Experiência profissional em na implementação, avaliação ou monitoramento de programas de conformidade com a LGPD, ou GDPR, ou outros referenciais internacionais.

Idiomas exigidos:

- Fluência em português é requerida.

- Nível intermediário de inglês é desejável.

Equal opportunity

As an equal opportunity employer, UNDP values diversity as an expression of the multiplicity of nations and cultures where we operate and, as such, we encourage qualified applicants from all backgrounds to apply for roles in the organization. Our employment decisions are based on merit and suitability for the role, without discrimination.

UNDP does not tolerate harassment, sexual harassment, exploitation, discrimination and abuse of authority. All selected candidates, therefore, undergo relevant checks and are expected to adhere to the respective standards and principles.

UNDP reserves the right to select one or more candidates from this vacancy announcement. We may also retain applications and consider candidates applying to this post for other similar positions with UNDP at the same grade level and with similar job description, experience and educational requirements.
